title: lucy Flight
description: A task: a goal, a delivery path (its runway and how its result is delivered), an autonomy posture and an acceptance test. A Flight that lacks any of them is admitted but not ready, and is never dispatched (LUCY-SPEC-012).

shape.description: ship lands a change; research returns knowledge and ships nothing.

runway.description: The Runway (project) in the Flight's namespace that the result is delivered to.

delivery.description: How the result is delivered: pull-request (a ship Flight's change, against the runway's default branch) or report (a research Flight's findings).

autonomy.description: How much the Flight may do on its own: owner (merges only on the owner's word), green (green pull requests merge, except the fixed list) or client (after the client confirms and the owner relays it). Never assumed.

acceptance.description: The acceptance test: what must hold for the Flight to be done.
